title: V1 Lux Matte Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Fox Racing V1 Lux Matte Black is engineered for punishing motocross motos and technical single-track trails, delivering lightweight balance and wide-vision goggle accommodation. Featuring a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan architecture at a featherweight 1322g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~97 dB aero profile. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Entry MX with MIPS liner and magnetic visor release system.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Fox Racing V1 Lux Matte Black is a motocross/dirt helmet designed for off-road use. It features an open-face design typical of MX helmets, prioritizing ventilation and lightweight construction over full-face protection standards like DOT or ECE.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Fox Racing V1 Lux Matte Black: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Fox Racing's Dirt / MX lineup, the V1 Lux Matte Black brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Fox Racing V1 Lux Matte Black represents Fox Racing's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~97 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Fox Racing V1 Lux Matte Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
